note: Table row for 2018-19: hectares burnt 288,000, homes destroyed 37, lives lost 0 (whole NSW season). NSW RFS Bush Fire Bulletin Vol 41 No 1 (2019) likewise says of July-Oct 2018 "not a single life was lost" and of the Feb 2019 north-east fires "there was no loss of life". Zero therefore means no deaths other than that aviation death.
